subject: RHive (integrating R and Hive) connection issues

messages.author: c604b89d9c6ef07d
messages.subject: RHive (integrating R and Hive) connection issues
parts:
Hi everyone,
I believe that some one might have used this package for integrating R
and Hive.
Well like other packages provided by CRAN, i have downloaded this
package along with the dependency package (rjava and Rserve) and put
it in the library folder of R.

I also ran the command which locates the java in the system. (R CMD
javareconf )
While loading the RHive package, no error is thrown..
rhive.init() function doesnt throw error..

When i am trying to connect rhive.connect("IP-Address") it throws the
following error:

> rhive.connect()
Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod",
cl, :
org.apache.thrift.transport.TTransportException:
java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused

I am using hadoop-0.20.2 ( RHive runs on -20.2.3) Hive-0.7.1 and
java1.6.0_27..I am using two node cluster

Any ideas whats happening?

Regards,
Som Shekhar

messages.author: f1ffce7fe5d18be9
messages.subject: Re: RHive (integrating R and Hive) connection issues
parts:
Hi Som,

I think I had a similar problem to you and just found a solution. All
I had to do was to run a hiveserver service on the head-node. More
specifically, I just started 'hive --service hiveserver 2> /tmp/
hiveserver.log &' on my development server. Now, if I run
'rhive.connect()' in R, all works great and as expected! I should say
that I am using RStudio Server on the same server which runs the
Hiveserver. This works excellent!


Enjoy,

Ralf Herbrich
